calculation_handling.description: Condition on enlarging or replacing an existing semi-detached house or duplex: the building must comply with the detached house regulations of the RD zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the existing building and its history; not evaluable from lot data.

units.disclosure: Applies only to a semi-detached house or duplex that existed on October 15, 1980. The enlarged or replacement building must meet the RD detached house regulations. This depends on the existing building and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on enlarging or replacing an existing semi-detached house or duplex: the building must be on the same lot that existed on October 15, 1980.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the lot history; not evaluable from lot data.

units.disclosure: The enlarged or replacement building must be on the same lot that existed on October 15, 1980. Lot history is not held, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on having more than one secondary suite: the original building existed on the lot on October 15, 1960.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the age of the original building; not evaluable from lot data.

units.disclosure: More than one secondary suite is allowed only if the original building existed on the lot on October 15, 1960. Building history is not held, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on having more than one secondary suite: the average interior floor area of the dwelling unit and the secondary suites combined is at least 110 square metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: An average across several units is not a single per-unit bound and needs the unit layout.

units.disclosure: The dwelling unit and secondary suites combined must average at least 110 square metres of interior floor area. An average across units is not evaluated.

evidence.secondary_suite: individual dwelling unit and secondary suite

calculation_handling.description: Minimum interior floor area of 55 square metres for each individual dwelling unit and secondary suite where more than one secondary suite is contained.
calculation_handling.gaps: Unit-by-unit floor areas are scenario inputs, not lot data.

units.disclosure: none

calculation_handling.description: Condition on having more than one secondary suite: no exterior addition or major exterior alteration is made and the external appearance is not materially altered.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the existing building and the proposed work; not evaluable from lot data.

units.disclosure: No exterior addition or major exterior alteration may be made, and the building must keep the external appearance of the original house. This is a design judgement and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on vertically dividing a detached house into a semi-detached house: the original building is at least 20 years old and any earlier addition at least five years old.
calculation_handling.gaps: Building age is not held.

units.disclosure: A detached house may be divided vertically only if the original building is at least 20 years old and any prior addition at least five years old. Building age is not held, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on vertically dividing a detached house: any addition for the alteration is not located at the front or sides of the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the location of a proposed addition; not evaluable from lot data.

units.disclosure: Any addition made for the vertical division must not be at the front or sides of the building. This depends on the proposed design and is not evaluated.

evidence.detached_house: detached house in the RD zone

calculation_handling.description: Condition on vertically dividing a detached house: any addition for the alteration complies with the building requirements for a detached house in the RD zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on a proposed addition; not evaluable from lot data.

units.disclosure: Any addition made for the vertical division must meet the RD detached house building requirements. This depends on the proposed design and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension above the first storey of a lawfully existing detached house must comply with the minimum building setbacks of this By-law.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the existing building and the proposed addition.

units.disclosure: none

calculation_handling.description: Condition on enlarging an older detached house to the rear: the overall floor space index including the addition does not exceed 0.69.
calculation_handling.gaps: Relief from the 0.6 floor space index for an enlargement of an existing building; depends on the existing building.

units.disclosure: Where the permitted floor space index is 0.6 and the detached house was built before October 15, 1953, a rear addition may bring the total to 0.69. This is a relief for an enlargement of an existing building and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on enlarging an older detached house to the rear: all finished floor levels in the addition are no higher than the uppermost floor level of the existing building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the existing building and the proposed addition.

units.disclosure: Finished floor levels in the rear addition may be no higher than the uppermost floor level of the existing building. This depends on the design and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on enlarging an older detached house to the rear: no part of the addition is closer to the nearest side lot line than the shortest distance between the existing side main wall and that lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: Relative to the existing building; no fixed distance.

units.disclosure: No part of the rear addition may be closer to the nearest side lot line than the existing side main wall is. This is relative to the existing building and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition on enlarging an older detached house to the rear: any prior addition is at least 5 years old.
calculation_handling.gaps: Building age is not held.

units.disclosure: Any earlier addition must be at least 5 years old. Building age is not held, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A platform with a floor higher than the first floor of the building above established grade may not encroach into the required front yard or rear yard setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the platform floor height relative to the first floor of the building.

units.disclosure: none

calculation_handling.description: On a lot with a lot frontage of 7.6 metres or less, a vehicle entrance through the front wall of a residential building is not permitted.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lot frontage test is evaluable; the location of a vehicle entrance in the front wall is a design fact.

units.disclosure: none

calculation_handling.description: Required parking spaces for a dwelling unit must be located within a building or structure.
calculation_handling.gaps: Parking location is a design fact.

units.disclosure: none

900.3.10(1437).explanation: Exception RD 1437 sets site specific rules for these lands: limited rights to enlarge, replace or divide older houses, a minimum floor area for secondary suites, a platform encroachment ban, a vehicle entrance ban on narrow lots and in-building parking. Former City of Toronto by-laws and sections continue to prevail on named addresses and are not evaluated.
